name: Petersberg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:4:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Petersberg (a church between stars on blue above a lion on yellow).
history: The flag is blue, white and blue striped 1:4:1, with the stripes running horizontally in the transverse form and vertically in the longitudinal form.

features.role: Petersberg arms — church, stars and lion
